name: Jack Renner
personality: Cocky, reckless, thinks Dustwell owes him something.
description: Jack escaped from Frontier Compact custody and wants to use Dustwell as a hideout. The town wants him gone.
questHooks: Threatens the town unless someone helps him.
Claims he stole something from Frontier Compact that 'buzzes' when he sleeps.
Knows a Powder Ganger cell near Primm planning something big.
